trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR (reported, not fixed - MAJOR). (1) SS7a CONVENTION VIOLATION: item 1 writes the Hecke relation as '(T - q)(T + q^{-1}) = 0 becomes T^2 = 1'. AGENTS.md SS7a requires the generator sigma_i, never T. (Second occurrence in this batch; the first is prf:eigenvalue-product-expansion.) The algebra is right: at q = 1, (T-1)(T+1) = 0. (2) THE MARKOV LIMIT IS WRONG, TWICE OVER. The display says tr_M --(z -> 0)--> epsilon and item 2 says 'The Jones-Markov trace parameter z -> 0. The Markov trace ... degenerates to the augmentation map epsilon: k[S_n] -> k sending every group element to 1.' (a) z does NOT tend to 0: at q = 1 the canonical convention D gives z = q^3/(q^2+1) = 1/2, and the excised convention C gives z = sqrt(q)/(q+1) = 1/2 as well. (b) The two halves contradict each other: tr_M(sigma_i) = z, so a limit trace sending every group element to 1 requires z -> 1, not z -> 0; with z -> 0 the limit would send every transposition to 0. Proposed: state the limit that is actually meant (z -> 1/2 under both conventions) and derive what tr_M becomes there, or drop the epsilon identification. (3) STRUCTURAL: the trailing '**Archimedean specialisation.** What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall ...' banner is the LAST paragraph - nothing follows it. Same defect as prop:explicit-alpha-k-h4. (4) VERIFIED CORRECT: [2j+1]_q -> 2j+1 at q -> 1; hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} -> 0; J_K(1) = 1 for every knot; the V^{(x)n} decomposition persists with Specht modules.
